title: Scaffold Hop: Same Effect, Different Molecule
strategies: checker-baseline pad: echo the known active and append a little cheap filler (reproduces the checker baseline, ~0.1)

similarity-maximizing repair: never touch any position that carries a pharmacophoric feature ("don't risk activity"), only cost-optimize the filler positions -- novelty caps at 1-K/L because every feature-carrying position stays byte-identical to the known active

pharmacophore-preserving scaffold hop: realize an anchor only pins a feature's TYPE and CHAIN POSITION, never the fragment's identity; substitute an off-reference (cheaper, never-used-by-the-reference) fragment carrying the same type at the same canonical offset at EVERY position, including the feature ones -- novelty and cost-efficiency both saturate while activity stays fully preserved, decoupling the two objectives
